priyaSharma.quote: The seat booking feature alone saved me so many wasted trips to a full library.

danielCho.quote: Running our monthly book club is so much easier with the discussion boards built in.

amaraOkafor.quote: Coordinating donations and events used to be all spreadsheets. Now it’s all in one place.

liamFitzgerald.quote: The AI librarian recommended books I never would have picked myself, and I loved them.

ananyaIyer.quote: I renew books and track my reading streak from my phone now. It made reading a daily habit again.

marcusBenson.quote: The leaderboard turned my reading goal into a friendly competition with my whole floor.

fatimaAlRashid.quote: Setting up author talks and tracking RSVPs takes minutes now. Attendance has doubled since we joined.

kenjiTanaka.quote: Reserving a quiet study seat before exams saved my semester. No more hunting for a spot.

graceMwangi.quote: The discussion boards keep our conversations going long after the monthly meetup ends.

diegoFernandez.quote: Logging donated books with the QR scanner is so quick that cataloguing is almost fun now.

sarahOConnor.quote: Notifications remind me before a book is due, so I have not paid a late fee in over a year.

reservations.question: How do reservations work?
reservations.answer: If a book is checked out, you can reserve it and you’ll be notified as soon as it’s back on the shelf.

seatBookings.question: How do seat bookings work?
seatBookings.answer: Pick an open time slot on the seat map and it’s held for you until your session starts.

donations.question: Can I donate books?
donations.answer: Yes, submit a donation request and a librarian will review and approve it for the shared collection.

aiLibrarian.question: What is AI Librarian?
aiLibrarian.answer: A conversational assistant that recommends books based on your interests, mood, or reading history.

cta.heading: Become a member and start reading today
cta.description: Join the reading community, explore the library, and never lose track of a book again.
